source.manualTitle: LG LMHM2237BD Over-the-Range Microwave Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power and discharge HV
steps.body: Unplug the microwave or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge the high-voltage capacitor before touching any HV component. Never operate the unit with interlock switches bypassed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DISCONNECT THE POWER SUPPLY CORD FROM THE OUTLET WHENEVER REMOVING THE OUTER CASE.

steps.title: Continue after self-test entry
steps.body: Self-test mode entered (Defrost weight/time 2 sec → TEST). Continue with fault interpretation below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: §6-3 Self diagnosis — humidity sensor and PCB thermistor check.

steps.title: Service test shows F-4?
steps.body: Enter service test (Defrost weight/time 2 sec → TEST). Did display show F-4 (humidity sensor open or short)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: F-4 Humidity sensor open or short.

steps.title: Humidity sensor verified
steps.body: Service test PASS — humidity sensor circuit normal.
steps.oemOutcome: Service test PASS — humidity sensor circuit normal.

steps.title: Humidity sensor connector seated?
steps.body: Inspect humidity sensor connector and wiring at PCB. Reseat or repair harness.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect humidity sensor connector and wiring at PCB. Reseat or repair harness.

steps.title: Repair humidity harness
steps.body: Repair connector or harness and retest service mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repair connector or harness and retest service mode.

steps.title: Replace humidity sensor or PCB
steps.body: Replace humidity sensor assembly or main PCB (EBR75341201).
steps.oemOutcome: Replace humidity sensor assembly or main PCB (EBR75341201).
